QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` ... calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` on its own functions (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:572-575`). The threaded variant wraps them in a mutex."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer only vaguely mentions a "threaded variant" with a mutex. It doesn't say that MBEDTLS_THREADING_C selects a mutexed pair of functions versus a plain pair at compile time inside the init function.
